description.en: Link two CRM contacts with a typed relation such as parent, child, spouse, sibling, manager, report, colleague, partner, client, supplier, referrer, or referral. Use it to build family trees, company org charts, business relationships, and referral chains. Adding the inverse of an existing relation reuses the same link instead of creating a duplicate.
description.de: Verknüpfe zwei CRM-Kontakte mit einer typisierten Beziehung wie Elternteil, Kind, Ehepartner, Geschwister, Vorgesetzte:r, Mitarbeiter:in, Kolleg:in, Partner:in, Kund:in, Lieferant:in, Empfehlungsgeber:in oder Empfehlung. Damit baust du Familienstammbäume, Organigramme, Geschäftsbeziehungen und Empfehlungsketten auf. Die Gegenrichtung einer bestehenden Beziehung verwendet dieselbe Verknüpfung statt ein Duplikat zu erzeugen.

bot: Use this to record how a contact is connected to another contact. Pass the contact's ID as contactId and the other person's ID as relatedContactId. The relation is read from the first contact's point of view: 'parent_of' means contactId is the parent of relatedContactId, 'referred_by' means relatedContactId referred contactId. If the user refers to a person by name, list contacts first to find the matching ID.

inputs.bot: Family: parent_of, child_of, spouse_of, sibling_of, aunt_of (this contact is the aunt/uncle), nibling_of (this contact is the niece/nephew). Organization: manages, reports_to, colleague_of. Business: partner_of, client_of, supplier_of. Referral: referred_by (the other contact referred this one), referred (this contact referred the other). Symmetric types (spouse_of, sibling_of, colleague_of, partner_of) only need to be recorded once.
